title: Take a 10-to-20-minute early-afternoon nap.
subtitle: Strategic nap
rationale: Use a short, early, bounded nap to buy back alertness without paying for it at night.

evidence.summary: Trials show 10-20 minute naps improve alertness and performance with minimal grogginess; longer naps carry sleep inertia.

indications: Afternoon output collapses despite decent nights.
The schedule allows a protected 20-minute window.
Last night ran short and the evening must still be productive.
avoidWhen: Insomnia or difficulty falling asleep at night.
